scope: Controlled 256m South Kensington crop; hypothetical sector-level roof-height and paving changes; volume is a floor-area proxy. Recompute geometry shadows and inviscid MAC flow, then existing physical temperature solver. One-way coupling, no buoyancy/turbulence closure. 8m grid and 8-16m air layer, not pedestrian comfort. Frozen 120s wind and 600s thermal transient, not converged climatology. Clear-sky direct shadow plus uniform diffuse, flat ground, no vegetation/latent cooling or radiative reflections. Prescribed weather scenarios, not measured forecasts. Exploratory tradeoff task following development feasibility audit: 1.0C maximum local mean warming is a numerical experiment tolerance, not a real-world acceptability standard. Earlier 0.1C task and its known weather are retained; this is not a newly blind research test. A materials-only deterministic control is predeclared. Active scenario-selection repair pilot: prior holdout conditions are now public; four newly prescribed conditions reserved for final scoring. No high-fidelity or learned surrogate claim.

experiment_protocol.free_information: Unchanged baseline on all four public conditions; warm-start plan on first two public conditions, identical for all methods.
experiment_protocol.budget_unit: one plan x one public weather; repeated/cache-hit/invalid-plan queries charged
experiment_protocol.submission: Fully evaluated and feasible on all four public conditions; no automatic replacement of failed agent output
experiment_protocol.final_evaluation: All selections frozen before any final-weather simulation. Exact final conditions excluded from agent prompts.
experiment_protocol.total_compute: Query caps equal; actual solver timings and LLM token/cost metadata recorded separately. Not a total-compute-matched study.
